$comment: Isolated analyser toolchain. Kept OUT of the app's root composer.json on purpose: the app's composer.lock pins maennchen/zipstream-php 3.2.0 (requires PHP 8.3) while vendor/ actually holds 3.1.1, so any root-level `composer require` forces an unsatisfiable re-resolve on PHP 8.2. phpstan/phpstan has zero dependencies, so installing it here cannot affect the application's dependency tree.
